accelerator.kernel_launch_overhead_cycle.source: Reference measurement from the existing compiler: vector parameter dispatch, instruction issue and pipeline fill/drain per pass on Sphinx. Reused without a separate measurement for this build.

accelerator.spmm_row_cycles.source: Reference measurement from the existing compiler: sparse accumulator turnaround per row on Sphinx, rounded to eight cycles. Used when the sparse path is enabled; not separately characterized for this build.

soc.bank_switch_cycles.source: Scratchpad read round-trip delay used when a request stream switches banks.

accelerator.sa_output_pipeline.source: Stage storage comes from synthesized RTL; delays come from unstalled RTL handshakes. Writeback restart measures the gap from the previous command's last output enqueue to the next command's first output enqueue, including controller restart and forwarding. Store delays end at the first output beat; remaining beats follow payload width.

accelerator.sa_input_pipeline.source: Unstalled RTL intervals: last fill response to the first local-buffer output; array input to deskewed partial sum beyond geometric propagation; and partial sum to final-output enqueue. Payload, parameter word count, array dimensions and waits are calculated in code. Buffer-read intervals run from a local read request to the corresponding array-input handshake, without backpressure.

metadata.scope: Dense single-bank accumulation with performance counters enabled, direct INT24 stores and riding BF16 vector tails without fetched operands. The target identifies the characterized build. The compiler derives payloads, local-buffer reuse, slot placement and stalls from hardware configuration and mapping loops; bank reservations and array propagation remain architectural approximations. Small parameter-forwarding, vector-start and completion delays are omitted.
